meta.comment: Chioni — navigation manifest of the PLATEFORME space only (back-office Chioni, S4/ADR 0017). SEPARATE from nav-manifest.json, which its own meta declares CENTRE-ONLY: the operator is not a tenant, his entries have no business in the centre sidebar, breadcrumb or ⌘K palette. Same node contract as Vireo ({id,title,slug,icon,parent,section,order,badge,keywords,inMenu,alias}) and the same indexing code (indexManifest) — one contract, two data files. Slugs include the 'plateforme/' prefix so hrefForSlug maps 1:1 to routes.
